title: Boarding pass
brief: A flat boarding pass: route, passenger, gate and seat in mono codes, circular notches at the perforation, a barcode and a Save pass button on the stub.

inspiration.note: Took the idea of a ticket split by a perforation with half circle notches and a stub; airline, route, palette and layout are invented.
Took the idea of dense labelled data blocks with muted labels above values; typography and structure redesigned.
